blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Written from Jared's verified local notes (researched November 1, 2026). Listing-stated figures are labelled; unconfirmed items say so. No live feed filtered to 55+ homes yet.

In Chartwell, West Vancouver, the 55+ homes you can buy are Westview Terrace, Tudor Gardens and Lincoln Gardens (strata). The other seniors housing here, which you cannot buy into, is rental, retirement residence or care and subsidized rental. This page names each building, says what type it is and what the sources show, and covers local rules and the questions buyers ask. Anything no source states is marked unconfirmed.
55+ strata buildings you can buy in Chartwell

A current listing describes "a quiet, well-kept 25-unit concrete building (55+)" in the heart of Ambleside; a North Shore realtor's building guide also lists it among West Vancouver buildings that "all have a 55+ bylaw."
Built 1992; a current listing states "55+ age restriction, no pets," and building data records age restrictions.

Built 1988, 44 units. The North Shore guide lists it as a 55+ bylaw building; building data records "Age restrictions" without stating the age — the 55+ figure rests on the guide, so confirm on the Form B.
Rental, care and subsidized seniors housing in Chartwell (not for sale)

items.t: Chartwell Churchill House Retirement Residence — 150 West 29th St, North Vancouver: Chartwell describes it as "the North Shore's only retirement residence offering both independent and assisted living lifestyles," a boutique-style continuum-of-care residence at 29th Street West and Lonsdale Avenue, five minutes from Lions Gate Hospital. It is registered in BC's Assisted Living Registry (class SN), legal operator Chartwell Master Care LP. Rental/care — nothing to buy, and it is in the City of North Vancouver, not West Vancouver.

Kiwanis Manor (independent suites) — 959 21st St (Ambleside): The Kiwanis North Shore Housing Society's page labels it "55+ • WEST VANCOUVER," independent living; the society states most of its seniors communities offer below-market rental housing. The same address also carries a registered assisted-living residence — see the conflict note in the care section.

Westerleigh PARC — 725 22nd St (Ambleside/Dundarave edge): PARC Retirement Living's independent-living rental residence at 22nd and Marine Drive, LEED Gold certified, meals, fitness programs and transportation included.

Amica West Vancouver — 659 Clyde Ave: Independent living, registered assisted living suites and long-term care in one rental residence; registered in the Assisted Living Registry (class SN), operator WC Operating (Ivy BC) GP Inc.

Amica Lions Gate — 701 Keith Rd (Park Royal side): Independent living, assisted living and long-term care suites with Lions Gate Bridge and ocean views; registered in the Assisted Living Registry (class SN) at 701–721 Keith Road, operator WC Operating (Ivy BC) GP Inc.

Hollyburn House (Venvi Hollyburn House) — 2095 Marine Dr (Ambleside): Independent living, assisted living, residential care, short-term and respite stays, operated by Cogir Senior Living; registered in the Assisted Living Registry (class SN), legal operator WC Operating (British Columbia - 1) GP Inc.

Kiwanis Manor (assisted living) — 959 21st St: SOURCE CONFLICT, flagged: the Assisted Living Registry lists Kiwanis Manor at this address as a Registered assisted-living residence (class SN) with legal operator "Dundarave Assisted Living Residence Partnership," and Park Place Seniors Living publishes the assisted-living page for it — while the Kiwanis society describes the same address as its own 55+ independent living. Both an independent component and a registered assisted-living component at one address is the reading the sources support; the split of suites is UNCONFIRMED.

Inglewood Care Centre — 725 Inglewood Ave (Ambleside): Long-term care, 230 publicly funded beds, opened 1979, operated by the Baptist Housing Society (not-for-profit); access through Vancouver Coastal Health.

Kiwanis Manor — 959 21st St: is the District's verified non-profit below-market seniors rental (Kiwanis North Shore Housing Society; applications year-round). No other subsidized independent seniors rental building in West Vancouver was verified in the BC Housing Zone 1 directory or operator sources checked.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Chartwell

items.t: This file covers the whole District of West Vancouver: the Marine Drive corridor from the Capilano River and Park Royal in the east to Horseshoe Bay in the west, the Ambleside and Dundarave village flats, and the British Properties hillside above Highway 1. District-wide land use is guided by the Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 4985, 2018.

The District's civic and recreation core is in Ambleside: the West Vancouver Community Centre and Aquatic Centre at 2121 Marine Drive, West Vancouver Memorial Library at 1950 Marine Drive, the Seniors' Activity Centre at 695 21st Street, and Municipal Hall.

The hospital for the District is Lions Gate Hospital, 231 East 15th Street, North Vancouver (Vancouver Coastal Health), with the North Vancouver Urgent and Primary Care Centre at Suite 200, 221 West Esplanade, North Vancouver.

Where the seniors housing actually is: almost everything is in Ambleside. The District's registered assisted-living residences sit at 659 Clyde Ave, 701–721 Keith Rd (Park Royal side), 2095 Marine Dr and 959 21st St; its long-term care home is at 725 Inglewood Ave; its verified 55+ strata condos are at 1390 Duchess Ave, 843 22nd St and 2110 Marine Dr. Nothing seniors-branded was verified in Dundarave village proper, Caulfeild, Horseshoe Bay or anywhere on the British Properties hillside.

blocks.text: Local rules and plans in Chartwell

items.t: Retirement residences are regulated differently from strata: assisted-living suites (including Chartwell Churchill House's) are registered with BC's Assisted Living Registry, and publicly funded long-term care (Inglewood's 230 beds) is allocated through Vancouver Coastal Health after an assessment — neither is bought, and neither uses a strata age bylaw. Eligibility is the operator's/health authority's, residence by residence.
Zoning: Zoning Bylaw No. 4662, 2010: Houses sit in the RS single-family zones; the apartment and care stock concentrates in the Ambleside town centre under the OCP.

OCP: Official Community Plan Bylaw No. 4985, 2018, plus the Ambleside Centre Local Area Plan, implemented by provincial order effective April 7, 2026 after the District missed the December 31, 2025 deadline.

Property taxes: District of West Vancouver 2026 property taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on unpaid current taxes on July 2, 2026 and a further 5% on outstanding current taxes on September 2, 2026; water and sewer utilities are metered and billed quarterly.

Additional school tax: 0.2% on the residential portion of assessed value between $3 million and $4 million and 0.4% above $4 million for 2026, rising to 0.3% and 0.6% on January 1, 2027 — a routine line item at West Vancouver values.

items.t: BC 55+ strata rules

The brand and the neighbourhood share a name and nothing else. "Chartwell" in West Vancouver search results is Chartwell Drive and its two schools in the British Properties. Chartwell Retirement Residences has never appeared in this research with a West Vancouver address; its BC residences are organized by city on its own site and West Vancouver is not among them. Any page implying a Chartwell residence in West Vancouver is built on the name collision.

Operator brands churn faster than registries. Hollyburn House (2095 Marine Dr) is currently marketed as "Venvi Hollyburn House" by Cogir Senior Living; job postings from the transition period brand it Revera; the Assisted Living Registry's legal operator is "WC Operating (British Columbia - 1) GP Inc." The registry entry, not the brand, is the stable fact to cite.

One Ambleside address is claimed by two operators. At 959 21st St, the Kiwanis society describes its own 55+ independent living while the provincial registry lists a registered assisted-living residence under Dundarave Assisted Living Residence Partnership, with Park Place Seniors Living publishing that residence's page. Treat "Kiwanis Manor" as two products at one address until the operators confirm the split.

The District's biggest seniors-housing event is a rebuild, not a new brand. The Inglewood Campus of Care approval (September 21, 2026) replaces a 230-bed 1979 care home with 364 long-term care beds, then adds 200 independent living and 161 seniors rental units on the same Ambleside site — more new seniors homes than every private residence opening in this file combined, and wait lists run through Baptist Housing, not the District.

All of the District's care capacity is on the Ambleside flat. The four Assisted Living Registry entries, the one long-term care home and all three verified 55+ strata buildings sit within a few blocks of Marine Drive between Clyde Avenue and 22nd Street. The hillside and the western villages have no registered seniors housing at all — a fact a "West Vancouver seniors" page should state rather than paper over.

Chartwell's North Shore foothold is one boutique residence. Churchill House's marketing point — the North Shore's only independent-plus-assisted-living residence under the Chartwell brand — also means a West Vancouver senior who specifically wants Chartwell has exactly one option, and it requires crossing into North Vancouver.

faq.q: Is there a Chartwell retirement residence in West Vancouver?
faq.a: No. Chartwell has no West Vancouver residence. Its only North Shore residence is Chartwell Churchill House, 150 West 29th St in North Vancouver (independent + assisted living, rental). Anyone advertising a "Chartwell in West Vancouver" is confusing the brand with the Chartwell neighbourhood in the British Properties.

faq.q: What are the Chartwell-style options actually in West Vancouver?
faq.a: The same product type — rental retirement living with care on site — is offered by Amica West Vancouver (659 Clyde Ave), Amica Lions Gate (701 Keith Rd) and Hollyburn House (2095 Marine Dr), plus independent-living rental at Westerleigh PARC (725 22nd St). All are rental; none is Chartwell, and none is strata ownership.

faq.q: What 55+ homes can I buy in West Vancouver?
faq.a: The verified age-restricted strata set is three Ambleside buildings: Westview Terrace (1390 Duchess Ave), Tudor Gardens (843 22nd St) and Lincoln Gardens (2110 Marine Dr).

faq.q: Does Chartwell Churchill House let a resident age in place?
faq.a: That is its stated model: Chartwell markets it as a continuum of care — independent living and assisted living in one residence, so support can be added without moving. It is the North Shore's only Chartwell and, by Chartwell's own description, the North Shore's only residence offering both lifestyles.

faq.q: Is there below-market seniors rental in West Vancouver?
faq.a: Yes — Kiwanis Manor, 959 21st St in Ambleside, run by the non-profit Kiwanis North Shore Housing Society as 55+ independent living at below-market rents for most of its communities, applications year-round.
Lions Gate Hospital, 231 East 15th Street, North Vancouver, serves the whole North Shore; Chartwell Churchill House markets itself as five minutes from it.

faq.q: If I need long-term care, what exists in West Vancouver itself?
faq.a: Inglewood Care Centre (725 Inglewood Ave), 230 publicly funded beds operated by Baptist Housing Society, allocated through Vancouver Coastal Health — and its approved redevelopment (District approval September 21, 2026) rebuilds it at 364 beds in Phase 1, then adds 200 independent living units and 161 seniors rental units in Phase 2.
